column1: # The jars the reference recipes run Apache Tika's own code from (`just charsoup-reference` for the CharSoup
# language detector, `just junk-reference` for the JunkDetector and Mojibuster, `just mime-reference` for the
# default detector), from Maven Central, then SHA-256, then the directory beside the jars a jar goes to when it
# belongs to one recipe's class path only. The Tika artifacts must be the version
# extractous-core/tika-native/build.gradle pins. Sources jars go to the sources/ directory beside the jars,
# off the reference recipes' class paths. The mime/ jars are the native image's class path as far as its
# detection reaches, at the versions the image resolves, in the order the image has them.
